data.fund_name: CANARA ROBECO MULTI ASSET ALLOCATION FUND
data.fund_type: An open-ended scheme investing in Equity & Equity related instruments, debt & money market instruments, Gold ETFs, and Silver ETFs.
data.investment_objective: To generate long-term capital appreciation from a portfolio investing in Equity and Equity related Instruments, Debt and Money Market Instruments, Gold ETFs and Silver ETFs. There is no assurance that the investment objective of the Scheme will be achieved.
data.asset_allocation: Equity and Equity-related Instruments 65% to 80% Debt and Money Market Instruments 10% to 25% Gold ETFs and Silver ETFs 10% to 25% Units issued by InvITs 0% to 10%
data.benchmark: 65% BSE 200 TRI + 20% NIFTY Short Duration Debt Index + 10% Domestic Price of Gold + 5% Domestic Price of Silver
data.fund_managers: Mr. Amit Kadam/ Ms. Ennette Fernandes/ Mr. Kunal Jain / Mr. Avnish Jain
data.exit_load: 1% - if redeemed/switched out above 12% of allotted units within 365 days from the date of allotment. Nil - if redeemed/switched out upto 12% of allotted units within 365 days from the date of allotment, Nil - if redeemed/switched out after 365 days from the date of allotment.
